h1: How to send new HubSpot contacts to Slack
answer: HubSpot's free Slack app does not post new contacts, so use a Professional workflow or an automation tool.
Either way, post only the contacts someone should act on, and name the owner, or the channel becomes noise.

method.h2: How to send HubSpot contacts to Slack, step by step

steps.title: Decide which contacts deserve a ping
steps.body: All new contacts is rarely right. Pick a rule a salesperson would agree with: from a form, lifecycle stage Lead or later, a country you sell in, or a company email domain.

steps.title: Create the channel and add the app
steps.body: A channel such as #new-leads keeps alerts out of chat. For a private channel, add the HubSpot or automation app to it first.

note.text: If the app is not in a private channel, posts fail without a sound.

steps.title: Set the trigger and the filter
steps.body: Trigger on new contacts. If your tool only has new or updated, keep contacts created since the last run with a filter on create date. Then add your rule from step 1.

note.text: "New or updated" fires on every property change, so one contact can post five times a day. The create-date filter stops it.

steps.title: Write the message
steps.body: Name, company, email, source and owner, with a link to the contact record last. Four or five fields read at a glance; fifteen do not.

steps.title: Give empty fields a fallback
steps.body: A contact with no company or owner prints a blank. Use "no company given" and "unassigned" so the message still reads.

steps.title: Test with two contacts
steps.body: Create one test contact that matches the rule and one that does not. Check that only one posts, then delete both.

captain.line: Captain plans an automation from one real HubSpot contact and tests it with sends held back. Each Slack post waits for your yes; the sheet row runs on its own.

wrong.title: A CSV import floods the channel
wrong.body: Importing 400 contacts creates 400 new contacts. Pause the automation before a big import, or filter out the import source.

wrong.title: One contact posts again and again
wrong.body: The trigger fires on updates. Filter on create date, or switch to a new-only trigger if your tool has one.

wrong.title: Nobody is tagged
wrong.body: New contacts often have no owner yet, so the @mention is empty. Post to the channel and let the owner read "unassigned" until routing runs.

wrong.title: Personal data in a busy channel
wrong.body: Phone numbers and notes in a 60-person channel are more exposure than the job needs. Post the name, company and a link; keep the rest in HubSpot.

faqs.q: Can HubSpot notify Slack about new contacts without Zapier?
faqs.a: Yes, with a workflow and the "Send a Slack notification" action, on a Professional or Enterprise plan. The free Slack notifications cover form submissions and mentions, not every new contact.

faqs.q: Can I post only qualified leads?
faqs.a: Yes. In a HubSpot workflow, set the enrolment rule on lifecycle stage or lead status. In an automation tool, add a filter step after the trigger.

faqs.q: Can I tag the contact owner in the message?
faqs.a: HubSpot's own workflow action can @mention the record owner, for users who have mapped their email. In other tools, look up the owner's Slack user from their email, or post their name as text.
